clauses.why: The verse says 'my land'; 'the land of Israel' is stated only in the following verse, so the citation needs widening.
clauses.english: was brought by God against the land of Israel in the latter days
clauses.ukr: був виведений Богом на землю Ізраїлю наприкінці днів
clauses.deu: wurde von Gott zur letzten Zeit in das Land Israel kommen gelassen
clauses.spa: fue traído por Dios contra la tierra de Israel al cabo de los días

clauses.why: The verse says God would leave a sixth of 'thee', not of his host, and the Ukrainian and German texts do not give the sixth part, so only the turning back is kept.
